long_description:
Endstack is a full desktop, collaborative workspace built for humans and agents running in the cloud available on web, desktop, and mobile.

Each workspace powered by endOS, giving you a familiar channel-based experience augmented by a real desktop environment. The desktop is backed by Linux and ships with a built-in Chrome browser. Files, notes, browser tabs, native apps, terminal, and all your agents in a single beautiful, unified interface. 

At the center of it all you get a powerful agent running 24/7 that you can also reach via Slack, email, or SMS.
name: Endstack
one_liner: The complete, collaborative workspace for humans and agents
